# Chapter 14 — 你看过那个电影吗 (Have You Seen That Movie?)

**Pinyin:** Nǐ kànguo nàge diànyǐng ma  
**Source:** *HSK Standard Course 2*, printed pages 105–112 (source image pages 125–132).

## New Words

| No. | Chinese | Pinyin | English | Source |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 有意思 | yǒu yìsi | interesting; fun | p. 106 |
| 2 | 但是 | dànshì | conj. but; still; yet | p. 106 |
| 3 | 虽然 | suīrán | conj. although; though | p. 106 |
| 4 | 次 | cì | m. time; occurrence (frequency complement) | p. 106 |
| 5 | 玩儿 | wánr | v. to play; to have fun | p. 106 |
| 6 | 晴 | qíng | adj. sunny; fine; clear | p. 107 |
| 7 | 百 | bǎi | num. hundred | p. 107 |

The numbered New Words list has seven entries and no numbered subentries. The p. 105 warm-up separately uses **电影演员、等、晴、一百、打电话、玩儿** as picture-matching prompts; these are activity items, not additional numbered entries. Page 105 also asks learners to name pictured objects, without supplying a numbered vocabulary list.

## Proper Names

No proper names are listed in the New Words section.

## Unique Hanzi in New Words

Distinct characters in the seven numbered entries, listed once in order of first appearance: **有、意、思、但、是、虽、然、次、玩、儿、晴、百** (12 characters).

## Characters

The Characters section on printed p. 111 teaches two radicals, separately from the New Words list:

- **雨** (雨字头): generally related to clouds, rain, and weather phenomena; examples **雪** (xuě, snow) and **雾** (wù, fog; mist).
- **贝** (贝字旁): generally related to money or valuable objects; examples **财** (cái, wealth; money) and **货** (huò, goods; commodity).
